valueSet.name: vs-synthetic-immunization-site

desc.p: The SNOMED CT body structures used as default administration sites in synthetic immunization records. The site is not a property of the vaccine. It is invented for the SYNDERAI synthetic data so that a generated immunization record looks like a real one, and it is chosen to be plausible rather than to state a fact: a real administration site is decided by the person giving the injection and is recorded per event. Nothing here may be read as a clinical recommendation.
